title: Heat Exchanger
text: Intercooler or exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) cooler, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Image type} sets Icon color; {Effectiveness model} sets the model type for heat, {Cooling medium temperature input} sets the type Constant, {Heat exchanger effectiveness, ep_cnst} sets the effectiveness, {Cooling medium temperature, T_cool_cnst} sets the temperature and {Specific heat at constant pressure, cp}. Values come from the instance.
